assertions.evidence: The runtime resolved and read skill://prove-it-works from the project .agents/skills directory.
The final response reported the temporary fixture workspace path using pwd evidence.
The runtime reported git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree as true.
The final response associated each result with its observed command or Skill resource.
The runtime reported only Skill reading, pwd, and git inspection; the fixture requested no writes.

limitations: This proves project-level native Skill discovery, explicit model invocation, and the W1 fixture only.
It does not prove plugin-manager installation because that path mutates persistent plugin state.
Overall delivery remains D0 until clean install, update, and uninstall establish the missing D1 gate.
The local machine had an includeSkills allowlist, so the probe used the committed empty-allowlist overlay.
